name: prometheus-query
description: Prometheus integration — run instant and range PromQL queries and inspect alerts, scrape targets, and label values via the Prometheus HTTP API. Works with a plain Prometheus server or a token/basic-auth proxied setup (e.g. Grafana Cloud).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Prometheus metrics, PromQL queries, alerts, and targets

fields.label: Server URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of the Prometheus server (the /api/v1 path is appended automatically).

fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.helpText: Optional bearer token for proxied/authenticated setups such as Grafana Cloud.

fields.label: Basic Auth Username
fields.helpText: Optional username for HTTP basic auth (used only when no bearer token is set).

fields.label: Basic Auth Password
fields.helpText: Optional password for HTTP basic auth.

tools.name: prometheus.query
tools.description: Run an instant PromQL query and return the result vector/scalar at a single point in time.

query.description: PromQL expression, e.g. up or rate(http_requests_total[5m])

time.description: Optional evaluation timestamp (RFC3339 or Unix seconds); defaults to now

tools.name: prometheus.query_range
tools.description: Run a PromQL query over a time range at a fixed resolution step (returns a matrix).

query.description: PromQL expression to evaluate over the range

step.description: Resolution step, e.g. 15s, 1m, 1h, or a number of seconds

tools.name: prometheus.list_alerts
tools.description: List the currently active alerts known to the Prometheus server.

tools.name: prometheus.list_targets
tools.description: List the active scrape targets and their health (job, health, scrape URL).

tools.name: prometheus.label_values
tools.description: List all values for a given label name across the server's series.

label.description: Label name, e.g. job, instance, or __name__ for metric names
